inline_text:
## Why
The Chapters List reached 100 live chapters, which is the cap. Two cities have Accepted organizers and no chapter yet: Columbus and Philadelphia. Both the Drive-folder guard in `create_chapter.py` and the feed-row guard in `sync_chapters.py` refused them. The decision was to raise the cap to 125 rather than retire an existing chapter.

## What
- `CHAPTER_CAP` goes from 100 to 125. The comment records when it was set and when it was raised.
- `test_chapter_cap.py` computes its expected values from `CHAPTER_CAP` instead of hard-coding 98, 100 and 101.
- Prose says "the chapter cap" instead of "100-chapter cap", and "one short of the cap" instead of "99", so the next change is one line.
- Left alone: the `aaif-sync-chapters` `description:` still says "100-chapter cap". Editing a description needs an eval run first (see `evals/README.md`), and that wording is only a trigger phrase.

## Checks
`test_chapter_cap`, `test_chapter_health`, `test_sync_chapters`, `test_create_chapter`, `test_sync` and pre-commit on the changed files all pass.
